content.text:
New message in #sales:

mike: does anyone know the current MRR for Acme Corp?

input.text: Hi Mike — I don't have access to the CRM or billing system to look that up, so I can't confirm Acme Corp's current MRR. Best to check with someone who has direct access (finance/billing or your CRM admin), or pull it from the source directly. Apologies I can't be more help here!

content.text: I let Mike know I can't look up the MRR since I don't have CRM/billing access — rather than guess or fabricate a number, I pointed him to the right people to ask.
